Dream 2026-11-22 linked 3 vignettes from 3 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-25 · touches · "Our goal is to eventually get one consistent process that is understood." (One consistent process: map every system for adding and classifying jobs (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-27 · touches · "We have a map of our flow, and a set of tasks that have been prepared." (Add our notes to the flow map and review the prepared tasks: all work flows in through the same system (2026-10-27))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "This process feels like one that we should remember." (Remember this process: create a holon, scan the chain, mark it in progress, settle decisions by principle, walk delivery, split if unsafe, pre-empt stops with one focused owner session (2026-10-28))
